clips.title: The story
paras: Near the eastern path outside the Valley of Trials, Ukor rests after carrying supplies from Razor Hill. The training grounds already had plenty, and he hopes the provisions can still help his people.

Ukor rests by the eastern road outside the Valley of Trials, tired from carrying food south from Razor Hill. Orc peons often spend their days cutting lumber or hauling rocks under harsh taskmasters. Ukor chose to bring provisions to the recruits on his own initiative. He crossed Durotar's red plains, where scorpids and boars prowl, only to find the training grounds already well-stocked. His bundle was not needed. Now he asks passing young adventurers to carry the provisions back north to Innkeeper Grosk.
